text: The core of materials science lies in revealing the intrinsic laws among "composition - structure - process - performance", and based on this, designing and preparing materials that meet specific requirements. The "materials" here cover a wide range, from semiconductor materials in chips to high-temperature alloys used in aerospace, from common plastics and metals to cutting-edge graphene and biomedical materials, all of which are the research objects of this discipline. This discipline, through interdisciplinary integration of chemistry, physics, and engineering, solves all-round problems from material research to application.
